verdict.rationale: Earning yield on balances is a fair question for a business account product like Wise Business, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions interest, yield or an investment feature on held balances. The multi-currency balance holding and the opt-in passthrough FDIC insurance are adjacent features, not yield.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can earn yield on operating cash balances without moving funds to a separate institution
